Dialogs, bulletins and Android helpers

Show host UI and run work on the proper thread.

Dialogs and feedback

ui.alert.AlertDialogBuilder supports message dialogs, buttons, lists and custom views. ui.bulletin.BulletinHelper provides transient messages, buttons and undo actions. Use the current fragment while it is still attached.

UI and background work

Use android_utils.run_on_ui_thread for Android UI. Use client_utils.run_on_queue or context.work.submit for background work. For styled messages, send_text(..., parse_mode="html") and parse_mode="markdown" convert markup to Telegram entities.
